breakdown.description: An n-type semiconductor with large donor density should have electrons as the majority carriers, not holes.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly identifies electrons as the majority carriers (n ≈ 1.0×10^22 m^-3) and holes as the minority carriers (p ≈ 1.0×10^10 m^-3), with n >> p. This directly fixes the inconsistency from the incomplete prompt where holes were incorrectly listed as the dominant carrier (p = 8.0×10^21 m^-3 > n = 1.0×10^18 m^-3). The generated output properly reflects the physics of an n-type semiconductor with large donor density.
